nous.note: Fill all four existing Nous pins before opting into ladder_mode aaii_bands; a rewrite never crosses providers.

_comment: Example configuration. Shadow is the shipped default; since v1.0.9 the Desktop panel values for enabled, mode and confidence_gate override this file when saved. With the example gates, free-pool confidence below 0.35 goes free, 0.35-0.65 flash, 0.65-0.80 mid and at least 0.80 free. Paid-pool confidence below 0.80 stays on source; paid_pool_routine_band true restores the v1.0.10 pool-agnostic below-0.35 free band. All downgrades require route_providers and source eligibility; escalation uses escalate_providers and its own source eligibility. source_mode any means provider match, allowlist uses route_models/escalate_models, and a list pins exact sources. ladder_mode legacy is the default; aaii_bands is opt-in and requires four existing Nous pins plus a resolver refresh. X-KFC-Router: off or router: off disables routing for that request. Model IDs are illustrative; free IDs expire. NOUS_API_KEY is read from the environment; the Jev client uses JEVI_API_KEY or its own optional creds file.
